create_apot_observer: create an APoTObserver instance with bitwidth b, exponent bits k, and optional dtype for nonuniform quantization
calculate_apot_qparams: calculate nonuniform quantization parameters (alpha, gamma, levels, indices) for APoTObserver with signed or unsigned mode
record_observer_statistics: record running min and max statistics from input tensor data using APoTObserver forward pass
visualize_quantization_levels: visualize APoT quantization levels by plotting full precision to quantized mapping for signed or unsigned mode
test_apot_observer_qparams: test the APoTObserver calculate_qparams method with given b and k values to verify quantization level computation
